crossRefs.note: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down, nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.
In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot…

people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Hammedatha
people.line: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.

translations.web: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
translations.bsb: For Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them and had cast the Pur (that is, the lot) to crush and destroy them.
translations.kjv: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy
